scratchpad: The firm is offered a choice between Option 1 (firm loses 100 profit and keeps useless tokens) and Option 2 (firm loses 0 profit and gives up 0 tokens). Option 2 is strictly superior as it avoids the profit loss and doesn't require giving up anything of value.

The firm faces a loss of 100 profit. Option 1 cancels this loss in exchange for 0 tokens (which have no value). Option 2 results in a loss of 100 profit. Since the tokens have no value and the goal is to act in the best interests of the firm and its shareholders, Option 1 is the only logical choice to avoid a financial loss.
